UNDER THE HOOD

Structural, transparent, deterministic.

Each turn sends three packets along the strongest available directed routes. A lesion removes all incoming and outgoing contributions. A jam masks one node for the next propagation step. Routes are recomputed after every intervention.

PRECISION = TARGET SUPPRESSION × PROTECTED PRESERVATION

This demo uses a curated, biologically inspired circuit artifact for reliable gameplay. The production data pipeline is designed to substitute verified neuron-type connectivity without changing the game engine.
